page.overview:
Who is Queen Mai?

Queen Mai is King Gorbak's wife and the mother of Prince Goro, heir to the throne of Kuatan, home of the Shokan people within Outworld.

Queen Mai, alongside her husband, rules over their kingdom and their people.
